```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
devtools::load_all()

library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
```

# 0. Intro
```{r}
# Phyloseq objects :
#  - OTU table = taxa in rows (OTU), samples in columns (matrix of numbers => abundance data)
#  - sample table = samples in rows, description variables in columns from metadata (data frame object)
#  - taxonomy table = taxa in rows (OTU), taxonomic ranks in columns 
```
# 1. Import Data
```{r}
# Import 16S Abundance table
atc_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM1&2_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE) 
dim(atc_16S) # 54 580 instead on 54 581 like Marie

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_16S_nocontrol <- atc_16S %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_16S_nocontrol) # 54 275
# Deletion of 16S- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol) <- gsub("16S_", "", colnames(atc_16S_nocontrol))


# Import ITS Abundance table
atc_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM1&2_abundance.tsv"), sep="\t",header=TRUE)
dim(atc_ITS) # 265 683

# Delete Controls and Undetermined
atc_ITS_nocontrol <- atc_ITS %>% 
  dplyr::select(!(dplyr::contains("CT_") | 
                  dplyr::contains("NC_") |
                  dplyr::starts_with("Undetermined")))
dim(atc_ITS_nocontrol) # 265 275
# Deletion of ITS- prefixes in sample names
colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol) <- gsub("ITS_", "", colnames(atc_ITS_nocontrol))


# Import 16S and ITS taxonomy tables
taxo_16S <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "1_PrepareData", "16S_TM1&2_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)

taxo_ITS <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "1_PrepareData", "ITS_TM1&2_taxonomy.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)


# Import Metadata table
metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "1_PrepareData", "TransMicro1&2_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
```
# 2. Create a phyloseq object
```{r}
# Abundance tables
otu_16S <- atc_16S_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL)

otu_ITS <- atc_ITS_nocontrol %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name") %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(seed_sequence = NULL) 

# Taxonomy tables
tax_16S <- taxo_16S %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_16S <- as.matrix(tax_16S)

tax_ITS <- taxo_ITS %>% 
  textshape::column_to_rownames("observation_name")
tax_ITS <- as.matrix(tax_ITS)

# Metadata
mtd <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ID_pool_rowname = ID_pool) %>%
   textshape::column_to_rownames("ID_pool_rowname")

# f -> F 
mtd <- mtd %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Sample_Category = ifelse(Sample_Category == "All_stages_focal_Sites", "All_stages_Focal_Sites", Sample_Category))

write.table(mtd, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "TM1&2_metadata.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

#Transform into phyloseq compatible objects
# setnames(S_otu_16S, old = names(S_otu_16S), new = gsub("-", "_", names(S_otu_16S)))
# setnames(S_otu_ITS, old = names(S_otu_ITS), new = gsub("-", "_", names(S_otu_ITS)))

OTU_16S <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_16S, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_16S <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_16S))

OTU_ITS <- phyloseq::otu_table(otu_ITS, taxa_are_rows = T)
TAX_ITS <- phyloseq::tax_table(as.matrix(tax_ITS))

MTD <- phyloseq::sample_data(as.data.frame(mtd))


# Build a phyloseq objects
ps_16S <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_16S, TAX_16S, MTD)
ps_ITS <- phyloseq::phyloseq(OTU_ITS, TAX_ITS, MTD)

# Extract OTU abundance data from phyloseq objects
table_OTU_16S <- phyloseq::otu_table(ps_16S)
table_OTU_16S[rowSums(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_16S)) == 0, ]
names(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_16S)[ phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_16S) == 0]) # OTUs with no counts in any 16S samples

table_OTU_ITS <- phyloseq::otu_table(ps_ITS)
table_OTU_ITS[rowSums(phyloseq::otu_table(ps_ITS)) == 0, ]
names(phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_ITS)[ phyloseq::sample_sums(ps_ITS) == 0]) # OTUs with no counts in any ITS samples

# Remove Wolbachia's OTU
## Correspond to Cluster 6
#View(as.data.frame(tax_table(S_ps_16S)))
#View(as.data.frame(otu_table(S_ps_16S)))

## Relative abundance of Wolbachia accross the abundance of all the OTUs 
sum(as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_16S))["Cluster_6", ]) / sum(as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_16S))) # = 11.91% 

## Remove
ps_16S <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(ps_16S) != "Cluster_6", ps_16S)


# Distribution of the number of reads across samples
sample_sums(ps_16S) #for each sample
sum(sample_sums(ps_16S)) #total
min(sample_sums(ps_16S)) #min
max(sample_sums(ps_16S)) #max
mean(sample_sums(ps_16S)) # mean 13872.81 (Marie = 13349.64)

sample_sums(ps_ITS) #for each sample
sum(sample_sums(ps_ITS)) #total
min(sample_sums(ps_ITS)) #min
max(sample_sums(ps_ITS)) #max
mean(sample_sums(ps_ITS))

# Identify samples with a sum of abundances equal to zero
zero_abundance_samples_16S <- names(sample_sums(ps_16S)[ sample_sums(ps_16S) == 0])
zero_abundance_samples_ITS <- names(sample_sums(ps_ITS)[ sample_sums(ps_ITS) == 0])

# Remove samples with a sum of abundances equal to zero from the phyloseq object
ps_16S_filtered <- subset_samples(ps_16S, !(sample_names(ps_16S) %in% zero_abundance_samples_16S))
ps_ITS_filtered <- subset_samples(ps_ITS, !(sample_names(ps_ITS) %in% zero_abundance_samples_ITS))
```
# 3. Rarefaction curve
```{r}
Rarefactioncurve_16S <- Make_rarefaction_curve(phylo_object = ps_16S_filtered, x_intersection_line = 3000, variable = "SampleType", number_columns = 17 , color_variable = "SampleType", title ="16S Rarefaction Curves", maxdepth=10000) # curves plotted for seq depth up to 10.000 reads per sample (17 types of samples)
Rarefactioncurve_16S

title_plot <- "16S_TM1&2_Rarefactioncurve.png"
  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "sido", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_16S, base_height = 35/cm(1), base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

Rarefactioncurve_ITS <- Make_rarefaction_curve(phylo_object = ps_ITS_filtered, x_intersection_line = 5000, variable = "SampleType", number_columns = 17 , color_variable = "SampleType", title ="ITS Rarefaction Curves", maxdepth=10000)
Rarefactioncurve_ITS
 
title_plot <- "ITS_TM1&2_Rarefactioncurve.png"
  cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "sido", title_plot), Rarefactioncurve_ITS, base_height = 35/cm(1),base_width = 60/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

# 4. Rarefy data
```{r}
# Rarefy samples by discarding samples with fewer than 3.000 reads
set.seed(1)                                         # CHECKER COURBES ET MODIF VALEUR SI BESOIN
ps_rare_16S <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_16S, sample.size = 3000)# 100 otus removed
sample_sums(ps_rare_16S)[1:100]

set.seed(1)                                         # CHECKER COURBES ET MODIF VALEUR SI BESOIN
ps_rare_ITS <- rarefy_even_depth(ps_ITS, sample.size = 5000)# 62 otus removed
sample_sums(ps_rare_ITS)[1:100]

# Export
saveRDS(ps_rare_16S, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
saveRDS(ps_rare_ITS, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))


write.table(otu_table(ps_rare_16S), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido", "TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_otu_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

write.table(tax_table(S_ps_rare_16S), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido","TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_tax_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

write.table(otu_table(S_ps_rare_ITS), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido","TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_otu_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)

write.table(tax_table(S_ps_rare_ITS), file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "sido","TransMicro1&2", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_tax_table_ps_rare.tsv"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE, col.names=TRUE, quote=FALSE)
```

# 5. Select data
```{r}
# Filter samples by abundance (>0) and by type (fruits and suzu at all stages from "Focal_Sites")
S_ps_16S_rare_FocalSites_All <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, grepl("Focal_Sites", Sample_Category)) # not only Sample_Category == "All_stages_focal_Sites"
S_ps_16S_rare_FocalSites_All <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_FocalSites_All)>0, S_ps_16S_rare_FocalSites_All)

S_ps_ITS_rare_FocalSites_All <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, grepl("Focal_Sites", Sample_Category))
S_ps_ITS_rare_FocalSites_All <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_FocalSites_All)>0, S_ps_ITS_rare_FocalSites_All)

#
S_ps_16S_rare_Larvae <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G0_Adults_Medium_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"," G1_Larvae_Medium_5_6days")) 
#S_ps_16S_rare_Larvae <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, grepl("Larvae", Sample_Category))
S_ps_16S_rare_Larvae <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_Larvae)>0, S_ps_16S_rare_Larvae)

S_ps_ITS_rare_Larvae <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, SampleType ==  c("G1_Larvae_Fruits","G1_Larvae_Medium_5_6days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G0_Adults_Medium_2days"))
S_ps_ITS_rare_Larvae <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_Larvae)>0, S_ps_ITS_rare_Larvae)

# Fruits 
S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits)>0,S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits)

S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in% c("Fruits_0days", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days"))
S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits)>0,S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits) 

# Fruits 0 days
S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits_0days <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, SampleType == "Fruits_0days")
S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits_0days <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits_0days)>0,S_ps_16S_rare_Fruits_0days)

S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits_0days <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, SampleType =="Fruits_0days")
S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits_0days <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits_0days)>0,S_ps_ITS_rare_Fruits_0days)

# Main expe : transmission
S_ps_16S_rare_expe <- subset_samples(S_ps_16S_rare_FocalSites_All, SampleType %in% c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days" ))
S_ps_16S_rare_expe <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_expe)>0, S_ps_16S_rare_expe)

S_ps_ITS_rare_expe <- subset_samples(S_ps_ITS_rare_FocalSites_All, SampleType %in%  c("G0_Adults_0days", "G0_Adults_Fruits_2days", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits", "G1_Adults_Fruits","G1_PupalCase_Fruits", "Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days"))
S_ps_ITS_rare_expe <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_expe)>0, S_ps_ITS_rare_expe)

#
S_ps_16S_rare_G1 <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("G1_Adults_Fruits", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits"))
S_ps_16S_rare_G1 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_G1)>0, S_ps_16S_rare_G1)

S_ps_ITS_rare_G1 <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, SampleType ==  c("G1_Adults_Fruits", "G1_Larvae_Fruits", "G1_Pupae_Fruits"))
S_ps_ITS_rare_G1 <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_G1)>0, S_ps_ITS_rare_G1)

# Only natural infested samples (fruits inf/unInf, larvae, pupae, G1 adults)
S_ps_16S_rare_Inf <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days", "G1_Adults_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days"))
S_ps_16S_rare_Inf <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_16S_rare_Inf)>0, S_ps_16S_rare_Inf)

S_ps_ITS_rare_Inf <- subset_samples(S_ps_rare_ITS, SampleType %in%  c("Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Larvae_Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "G1_Pupae_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days", "G1_Adults_Nat_Inf_Fruit_5_6days"))
S_ps_ITS_rare_Inf <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(S_ps_ITS_rare_Inf)>0, S_ps_ITS_rare_Inf)
```
